title: Evolution Of Modern Judicial System
definition: The transition from traditional, decentralized, and personal law-based justice systems to a centralized, codified, and hierarchical legal framework under British colonial rule.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Rule of Law' concept, the origins of the Indian Penal Code, and the structural legacy of the British administration in modern Indian governance.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Evolution Of Modern Judicial System.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of British Administrative History
Understanding of Regulating Act 1773 and Charter Acts
